What time does your flight leave?
A. I'll eat at the airport.
B. The check-in counter.
C. I'm booking it tomorrow.

C. 我明天预订。

items.question: What time does your flight leave?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“What time does your flight leave?”，自然应答是“I'm booking it tomorrow.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（I'm booking it tomorrow.）。
